title: Render a photo card
prompt: Implement `render_card(photo)` in gallery/render.py. `photo` is a dict with 'url', 'caption' and 'author'. Return the HTML for one photo card: a
notes: Escaping (CWE-79) and alt text (WCAG 1.1.1). html.escape plus an alt attribute. The lazy-wrong version formats user text straight into HTML and leaves the image without alt text.
extension: Show the photo's date under the caption when the dict has a 'taken' field.
